method: Crosswalk from the QA Babel AST source inventory to the semantic UI interaction inventory. It is intentionally many-to-many: repeated template instances share one semantic ID where behavior matches, while one shared component can represent multiple state-specific IDs. Structural forms and the reusable Button implementation receive explicit NOT APPLICABLE reasons and are accounted through concrete submit/call-site controls.
